evals.prompt: j'en ai marre du design de mon portfolio https://wiki.jdelgado.fr, refais-le, surprends-moi
evals.expected_output: Reads the site and its sitemap first, asks one call of four questions (identity hooks, tone, colour plus motion, hard no's), writes a brief with an architecture verdict and waits for an OK before any mockup.

evals.prompt: Je veux un site vitrine en React pour l'asso de randonnée de mon village, une dizaine de pages (sorties, adhésion, contact), mis à jour par le bureau une fois par mois
evals.expected_output: Does not default to a SPA: the verdict is an SSG with the cost of a SPA explained; Round 1 asks who updates content; the brief carries a page inventory and no design work starts before an explicit OK.

evals.prompt: le site de mon cabinet rame sur mobile, Lighthouse me met 38 en perf, je veux garder le design, vois si on peut optimiser
evals.expected_output: Skips the taste rounds, measures payloads and LCP first, asks one call for target, budget and build-step tolerance, and writes a plan ordered with before and after measurements on the deployed site.
